title: session.v1
description: A completed work session as a typed, signed record: the atom of an agent's work history. Minted by `treeship session close` from the session's own sealed evidence (never hand-written), and carried as the payload of a Treeship receipt artifact with kind=session.v1. See docs/specs/work-history.md.

actor.description: Actor URI the session ran as, e.g. agent://hermes.

headline.description: One-line human narrative of the session, from the sealed receipt.

outcome.description: How the session ended: completed | abandoned | failed.

harness.description: Capture surface(s) the session ran under: distinct tool runtime ids from the sealed receipt (e.g. 'claude-code'), or 'cli' when no tool runtime was involved.

custody.description: Who held the signing key, when that is not the actor. ABSENT means self-custody -- the actor signed for itself, the default and the strong case. Present means a service signed on the actor's behalf: a materially weaker claim, so it is recorded rather than inferred. Deliberately a separate axis from attestation_class, which grades how EVIDENCE was captured; this grades who held the KEY. They vary independently -- a service-mediated room can have excellent runtime-captured evidence and still be custodially signed. Under self-custody, forging a participant's action needs that participant's key; under delegated custody, a compromised service can mint any history for every actor it signs for. Same receipt shape, different threat model.

mode.description: Only 'delegated' is ever serialized. Self-custody is the absence of this whole object, so existing receipts stay byte-identical and 'no custody block' cannot be misread as 'custody unknown'.

signer.description: The identity whose key actually produced the signature, e.g. svc://gateway-rooms. This is who a verifier is really trusting.

on_behalf_of.description: The actor the signature is claimed to be FOR, e.g. agent://fizz. A verifier can confirm the signer signed; it cannot confirm this actor agreed, and must not present it as though it could.

reason.description: Why the actor did not sign for itself, e.g. 'browser-mediated room; participants hold no local key'.

attestation_class.description: How the record's evidence was captured, per the work-history ladder: self (the agent's own receipts, no external signal), runtime (events emitted by a harness hook or bridge the agent cannot forge or omit), countersigned (a second party signed evidence in the package, e.g. consumed human approvals). Labeled, never laundered; 'anchored' is a later, derivable state (publish + witness), not set at close.

action_count.description: Signed artifacts in the session chain.

approval_count.description: Approval uses consumed during the session (each backed by a signed grant embedded in the package).

event_count.description: Events in the sealed session event log.

tools_exercised.description: Tool names actually invoked during the session, computed from captured events (never hand-written). Feeds capability cards' `exercised` grade.

receipt_digest.description: Digest of the sealed session receipt (receipt.json) this record summarizes; binds the record to its evidence.

receipt_merkle_root.description: Merkle root of the sealed .treeship package, when composed.

report_url.description: Published session report URL, when one exists.

workflow_ref.description: Content-addressed workflow.v1 artifact selected in the signed session.start root action. Absent when the run was not workflow-bound.

room.description: Room this session hosted, when it was created with `treeship room create`. Mirrored here from session.json so `invitation_authority` -- which decides who may mint invitations -- is bound into the DSSE-signed payload rather than living only in unsigned local state. Absent (null) for ordinary, non-room sessions.

room_id.description: Stable room identifier, distinct from session_id.

host_pubkey.description: Base64url-no-pad Ed25519 public key the room's invitations are issued under.

invitation_authority.description: Who may mint invitations for this room.

delegates.description: Present only when kind is delegated_to.

participants.description: Finalized (both-signed) participant artifact ids, in join order.
